projects.title: Transport, Energy, and Emissions Across 54 African Countries
projects.summary: Building a large open database covering all 54 African countries — spanning demographics, transport infrastructure and demand, motorisation, emissions and targets, electric vehicles and charging, energy and fuel prices, hydrogen roadmaps, battery reuse and recycling, and transport policy.

projects.title: Informal Public Transport Systems in Four African Secondary Cities
projects.summary: Collecting, harmonising, and analysing data on informal public transport across four African secondary cities — from modes, routes, and ridership to fares, business models, and governance. The project fills priority data gaps through targeted fieldwork and stakeholder engagement, producing comparable, open, quality-assured datasets (shared via the Transport Data Commons) alongside city factsheets, a study brief, and practical planning and policy recommendations.
